requirements.value: Applicant must satisfy the requirements of the occupational credential portability program (C.R.S. § 12-20-202(3)), including proof of substantially equivalent experience or credentials, good standing in another state, and payment of applicable fees.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a license by endorsement to an applicant who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

exists.quote: The Colorado dental board is created as the agency of this state for the regulation of the practice of dentistry, dental therapy, and dental hygiene in this state and to carry out the purposes of this article 220.

national_association.quote: The board may recognize those dental specialties defined by the American Dental Association.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in this state except those who are duly licensed as dentists, dental therapists, or dental hygienists pursuant to this article 220

credential_type.quote: Grant and issue licenses and renewal certificates in conformity with this article 220 to applicants the board has found to be qualified.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in this state except those who are duly licensed as dentists, dental therapists, or dental hygienists pursuant to this article 220

title_protection.quote: Represents himself or herself to an individual or the general public as practicing dentistry, by using the words "dentist" or "dental surgeon", or by using the letters "D.D.S.", "D.M.D.", "D.D.S./M.D.", or "D.M.D./M.D."

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices or offers or attempts to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene without an active license issued under this article 220 is subject to penalties pursuant to section 12-20-407 (1)(a).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license or in taking examinations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any crime that constitutes a violation of this article 220.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or any crime that constitutes a violation of this article 220.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing a habit-forming drug or controlled substance other than in the course of legitimate professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing a habit-forming drug or controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), to a person, including the applicant or licensee, other than in the course of legitimate professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a violation of a federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution, or use of a controlled substance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a violation of a federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution, or use of a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitually abusing or excessively using alcohol, a habit-forming drug, or a controlled substance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitually abusing or excessively using alcohol, a habit-forming drug, or a controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misusing a drug or controlled substance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misusing a drug or controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person or a person with a suspended license to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting, in the practice of dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene, a person who is not licensed to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene under this article 220 or whose license to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene is suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing as a partner, agent, or employee of or in joint venture with any unlicensed person (subject to exceptions).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene as a partner, agent, or employee of or in joint venture with any person who does not hold a license to practice dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene within this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of this article 220 or any lawful rule or order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision or term of this article 220, an applicable provision of article 20 or 30 of this title 12, or any lawful rule or order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a physical illness, condition, or behavioral/mental health disorder that renders the licensee unable to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the board, as required by section 12-30-108 (1), of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder that renders the licensee unable, or limits the licensee's ability, to perform dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene services with reasonable skill and with safety to the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act or omission constituting grossly negligent dental practice or failing to meet generally accepted standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act or omission that constitutes grossly negligent dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene practice or that fails to meet generally accepted standards of dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in a manner that is misleading, deceptive, or false.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising in a manner that is misleading, deceptive, or false

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months following termination of the professional relationship.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months immediately following the termination of the licensee's professional relationship with the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to make patient records available to a patient pursuant to a written authorization-request.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to make patient records available to a patient pursuant to a written authorization-request under section 25-1-802

disciplinary_grounds.description: False billing in the delivery of dental services, including performing one service and billing for another, or billing for services not rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False billing in the delivery of dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene services, including performing one service and billing for another, billing for any service not rendered, or committing a fraudulent insurance act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing abuse of health insurance in violation of section 18-13-119.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing abuse of health insurance in violation of section 18-13-119

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board within 90 days of a final malpractice judgment or settlement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the board, in writing and within ninety days after a judgment is entered, of a final judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction in favor of any party and against the licensee involving negligent malpractice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish unlicensed persons with laboratory work orders.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish unlicensed persons with laboratory work orders pursuant to section 12-220-502

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing a solicitor or other agent to obtain patronage, except as provided by section 12-220-309.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing a solicitor or other agent to obtain patronage, except as provided in section 12-220-309

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully deceiving or attempting to deceive the board or its agents.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully deceiving or attempting to deceive the board or its agents with reference to any matter relating to this article 220

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sharing professional fees with anyone except those lawfully associated in the practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sharing any professional fees with anyone except those with whom the dentist, dental therapist, or dental hygienist is lawfully associated in the practice of dentistry, dental therapy, or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide reasonably necessary referral of a patient to other licensed professionals when required by generally accepted standards of care.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide reasonably necessary referral of a patient to other licensed dentists or licensed health-care professionals for consultation or treatment when the failure to provide referral does not meet generally accepted standards of dental care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and repeatedly ordering or performing demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or treatments without clinical justification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully and repeatedly ordering or performing, without clinical justification, demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect entries or failing to make essential entries on patient records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect essential entries or repeatedly failing to make essential entries on patient records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering local anesthesia, minimal sedation, moderate sedation, or deep sedation/general anesthesia without obtaining a permit from the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering local anesthesia, minimal sedation, moderate sedation, or deep sedation/general anesthesia without obtaining a permit from the board in accordance with section 12-220-411

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report within 90 days the surrender of a license or adverse action taken against a license by another state's agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board, within ninety days after final disposition, the surrender of a license to, or adverse action taken against a license by, a licensing agency in another state, territory, or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide adequate or proper supervision of unlicensed persons in dental practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide adequate or proper supervision of unlicensed persons in dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any conduct that constitutes a crime as defined in title 18 that relates to the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct that constitutes a crime as defined in title 18, which conduct relates to the licensee's practice as a dentist, dental therapist, or dental hygienist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing outside the scope of dental practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing outside the scope of dental, dental therapy, or dental hygiene practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to establish and continuously maintain financial responsibility or professional liability insurance as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to establish and continuously maintain financial responsibility or professional liability insurance as required by section 12-220-307

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising or holding oneself out as practicing a dental specialty without having completed the required education for that specialty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising or otherwise holding oneself out to the public as practicing a dental specialty in which the dentist has not successfully completed the education specified for the dental specialty as defined by the American Dental Association

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint filed against the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint filed against the licensee pursuant to this article 220

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards for infection control.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards for infection control

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering moderate sedation or deep sedation/general anesthesia without a licensed dentist or other qualified health-care professional present in the operatory.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering moderate sedation or deep sedation/general anesthesia without a licensed dentist or other licensed health-care professional qualified to administer the relevant level of sedation or anesthesia present in the operatory

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete and maintain records of completing continuing education as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to complete and maintain records of completing continuing education as required by section 12-220-308

insurance_required.quote: A licensed dentist, a licensed dental therapist, and a licensed dental hygienist must meet the financial responsibility requirements established by the board pursuant to section 13-64-301 (1)(a).

definition_quote.value: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, or the adjacent and associated structures and the impact of the disease, disorder, or condition on the human body so long as a dentist is practicing within the scope of the dentist's education, training, and experience and in accordance with applicable law.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, or the adjacent and associated structures and the impact of the disease, disorder, or condition on the human body so long as a dentist is practicing within the scope of the dentist's education, training, and experience and in accordance with applicable law.

value: treatment of oral cavity and maxillofacial area conditions
methods_authorized.quote: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment, including nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, or the adjacent and associated structures

drug_authority.value: A licensed dentist is authorized to prescribe drugs or medicine, perform surgical operations, administer local anesthesia, analgesia including nitrous oxide/oxygen inhalation, medication for relief of anxiety, minimal sedation, moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia pursuant to board rules. A dentist shall not prescribe habit-forming drugs or controlled substances other than in the course of legitimate dental practice.
drug_authority.quote: A licensed dentist is authorized to: (I) Prescribe drugs or medicine; (II) Perform surgical operations; (III) Administer, pursuant to board rules, local anesthesia, analgesia including nitrous oxide/oxygen inhalation, medication prescribed or administered for the relief of anxiety or apprehension, minimal sedation, moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: A licensed dentist who obtains an anesthesia or sedation permit pursuant to this section may administer minimal sedation, moderate sedation, or deep sedation/general anesthesia. A licensed dentist who administers minimal sedation, moderate sedation, or deep sedation/general anesthesia to pediatric dental patients shall obtain a permit designated by the board to allow for administration to pediatric dental patients.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The board shall establish, by rule, criteria and procedures for an office inspection program to be completed upon application and renewal of anesthesia or sedation permits

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: A licensed dentist who administers minimal sedation, moderate sedation, or deep sedation/general anesthesia to pediatric dental patients shall obtain a permit designated by the board to allow for administration to pediatric dental patients.

specialist_license_available.quote: The board may recognize those dental specialties defined by the American Dental Association.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means the supervision of those tasks or procedures that do not require the presence of the dentist in the room where performed but require the dentist's presence on the premises and availability for prompt consultation and treatment. "Indirect supervision" means the supervision of those tasks or procedures that do not require the presence of the dentist in the office or on the premises at the time the tasks or procedures are being performed, but do require that the tasks be performed with the prior knowledge and consent of the dentist. "Telehealth supervision" means indirect supervision by a dentist of a dental therapist or dental hygienist performing a statutorily authorized procedure using telecommunications systems.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: A dental hygienist proprietor, or a professional corporation or professional limited liability corporation of dental hygienists, in addition to providing dental hygiene services, may enter into an agreement with one or more dentists for the lease or rental of equipment or office space in the same physical location as the dental hygiene practice

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: Unsupervised dental hygiene may be performed by licensed dental hygienists without the supervision of a licensed dentist.

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: Effective May 1, 2023, every person who desires to qualify for practice as a dental therapist within this state must file with the board: A written application for a license

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: A dental therapist licensed pursuant to this article 220 who has completed one thousand hours or more under direct supervision... may practice the tasks and procedures identified in subsection (1)(a) of this section under the indirect supervision of a licensed dentist pursuant to a written articulated plan with the dentist that meets the requirements of subsection (2) of this section.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Only a dentist licensed to practice dentistry in this state pursuant to this article 220 may be the proprietor of a dental practice in this state.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A dentist is subject to the limitations on prescriptions specified in section 12-30-109.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A licensed dentist who uses the services of an unlicensed technician for the purpose of constructing, altering, repairing, or duplicating any denture, bridge, splint, or orthodontic or prosthetic appliance shall furnish the unlicensed technician with a written or electronic laboratory work order in a form approved by the board

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Telehealth supervision" means indirect supervision by a dentist of a dental therapist or dental hygienist performing a statutorily authorized procedure using telecommunications systems.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A licensed dental therapist or dental hygienist who obtains a local anesthesia permit pursuant to this section may administer local anesthesia.

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: "Interim therapeutic restoration" or "ITR" means a direct provisional restoration placed to stabilize a tooth until a licensed dentist can assess the need for further definitive treatment.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The dentist shall make the laboratory work order in a reproducible form, and the dentist and the unlicensed technician shall each retain a copy in a permanent file for two years.

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: Unsupervised dental hygiene may be performed by licensed dental hygienists without the supervision of a licensed dentist.
